final_draft.answer: Accounts of people who leave are disabled within 24 hours of their last day, through the identity provider.
final_draft.note: This uses the approved answer for control CC6.2 word for word. It is valid until 2027-11-17 and owned by security@harborlight.example. Section 4.3 of the Access Control Policy agrees and sets the same 24-hour limit. Only the approved answer names the identity provider as the way accounts are disabled. These sources say what should happen; they aren't evidence of what actually happens when someone leaves. None of the available live checks covers leaver offboarding, so I couldn't verify it.

policy:3047591c-e7c0-4cd9-9a2a-3a5b8df42: Access is removed within 24 hours of a person's last working day.
policy:2804d00d-1060-475f-814b-72f55f8df: Every workforce member has a named account. Shared accounts are not permitted.
answer:ba971fce-001c-431b-b552-a03200c1e: Accounts of people who leave are disabled within 24 hours of their last day, through the identity provider.
answer:7356897a-04b7-4676-a988-3fa695354: An independent firm performs a penetration test of the application and infrastructure once a year. A summary letter is available under NDA.
answer:24375dda-4531-47dc-8ae2-e53cb4b07: Yes. Multi-factor authentication is required for all employee accounts through our identity provider. SMS is not an accepted factor.
